result.title: MI-Hyper: Generating Multiple Instance Models for Weight Space Transfer Learning in Histopathology via Mixed Tasks Pretrained HyperNetwork
result.summary: Zero-shot whole-slide image (WSI) prediction aims to generalize to new pathology tasks without parameter updates at deployment. MI-Zero makes these predictions by pooling patch-text similarities. Conditional weight generation, combined with supervision from diverse pathology tasks, offers an alternative: learning to construct predictive rules from task descriptions. We introduce MI-Hyper, a hypernetwork pretrained across mixed tasks to generate the aggregation and classification weights of multiple instance learning (MIL) models. We first train the generator and a shared MIL basis jointly using source labels. We then freeze the basis and refine the generator. The generated task weights are reused across cases. Across 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, MI-Hyper improves mean AUC, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 over MI-Zero by 1.85, 1.17 and 0.57 percentage points, respectively. On some molecular prediction tasks, both AUC and balanced accuracy improve by more than 20 points. These results support task-conditioned weight generation as a promising approach to weight-space transfer for long-sequence modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MI-Hyper：在 52 个病理数据集、308 个混合任务上预训练超网络，按任务描述生成 MIL 模型的聚合与分类权重，先联合训练生成器与共享 MIL 基座、再冻结基座微调生成器，从而在零样本 WSI 预测上超过 MI-Zero。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务条件化的权重生成被用于长序列 patch 证据的聚合与判别，可能为 LVR 中「按任务筛选并汇聚视觉证据」提供线索；但其生成的是分类器权重而非推理期 latent 状态，且无动态计算与停止机制，联系需核查。
